body:
A build runs from a recorded copy of the source in a separate folder, with locked dependencies, not on the working tree as it is. D-246 point 1 left this to package inspection, so propose the decision change it needs.

- The release records which copy it was built from.
- Changes the human makes while a build runs don't reach that build.
- A file the build needs but the copy lacks fails the build, naming the file.

Done when: Solace's own workspace builds and passes from a recorded copy, and a file edited during the build doesn't change its outputs.
title: inspection: build from a recorded copy
